keyFindings.finding: Cloud & Networking segment net revenue grew to $1,006.3M in Q4 FY26, driven by record shipments of 800G optical components and initial volume deployments of 1.6T transceivers for AI datacenter clusters.
keyFindings.quote: The substantial increase in our net revenue was driven by accelerating demand from cloud hyperscale customers deploying high-density optical interconnects to support generative AI workloads.

keyFindings.finding: Non-GAAP gross margin expanded to 50.4% and non-GAAP operating margin expanded to 36.6%, benefiting from operating leverage and higher-margin 800G/1.6T product mix.
keyFindings.quote: Operating income benefited from fixed manufacturing cost absorption across our wafer fabs and packaging lines.

keyFindings.finding: GAAP net loss was $7.16B ($84.65/share) primarily due to a non-cash $7.76B loss on debt extinguishment from settling convertible notes as stock prices surged.
keyFindings.quote: The GAAP net loss for fiscal 2026 was largely impacted by the non-cash charge associated with the equitization and settlement of our outstanding convertible notes.

keyFindings.finding: Customer concentration remains elevated, with top cloud hyperscalers representing over half of datacom optical transceiver shipments.
keyFindings.quote: A small number of cloud and networking customers account for a substantial portion of our revenue, and any reduction or delay in orders could materially impact operating results.

keyFindings.finding: In-house Indium Phosphide (InP) wafer fab capacity and cleanroom assembly throughput are currently operating near maximum capacity.
keyFindings.quote: Our ability to meet customer demand for high-speed laser diodes and transceivers depends on timely expansion of our cleanroom facilities and equipment delivery.

newRiskFactors.priorLanguage: General cyclicality in cloud computing capital expenditure.
newRiskFactors.currentLanguage: Concentrated exposure to AI datacenter infrastructure deployment schedules; potential pauses in GPU cluster builds may result in rapid adjustments to transceiver demand.

newRiskFactors.risk: Wafer Fab and Assembly Capacity Allocation
newRiskFactors.priorLanguage: Normal manufacturing risks and supplier lead times.
newRiskFactors.currentLanguage: Capacity constraints in proprietary laser fabs and outsourced advanced assembly in Southeast Asia may restrict our ability to fulfill surging orders for 1.6T modules.

purchaseObligations.note: Capital equipment commitments for Indium Phosphide wafer fab tools and optical assembly cleanrooms in San Jose and Thailand.

legalProceedings.case: General intellectual property and patent monitoring
